meta.title: Onboarding Approval Workflow: refused for a user without the Approver role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Approver role on the specified tenant
Open and configure the Onboarding Approval Workflow with multi-level approval, query, and reject options
Verify refusal or absence of the workflow for the non-Approver
Repeat the workflow as an Approver and verify it is available
Compare the two users' outcomes while accounting for tenant-specific RBAC configuration
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Approver role on the specified tenant; Open and configure the Onboarding Approval Workflow with multi-level approval, query, and reject options; Verify refusal or absence of the workflow for the non-Approver; Repeat the workflow as an Approver and verify it is available; Compare the two users' outcomes while accounting for tenant-specific RBAC configuration

args.need: sign in as the non-Approver and the Approver on the same tenant, attempt the configurable Onboarding Approval Workflow with multi-level approval plus query and reject options for both users, and report whether the workflow is refused or absent for the non-Approver and available for the Approver, including any tenant RBAC configuration

Assert that no application error or crash occurred after the tester's role-based workflow check.
